verdict.rationale: Ashby's docs say the platform includes "CRM & Sourcing" alongside the ATS and covers recruiting "from outreach to offer." It also offers AI-driven rediscovery of existing candidates, and a community thread describes companies using Ashby to email sourced engineers, which suggests outreach email exists. However, the pack never describes the specific CRM mechanics the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented prospect/talent pools, personalized multi-step email sequences, open/reply tracking, nurture campaigns for future roles, and hands-on corroboration of the CRM workflow.
